Possibly they want to note that GCD(90,120) is twice GCD(45,60) because 90=2*45, 120=2*60. So GCD(90,120)=2*GCD(45,60). Similarly, GCD(72,96) is twice GCD(36,48). So we can compute GCD(45,60)=15. Then GCD(90,120)=30. Compute GCD(36,48)=12. Then GCD(72,96)=24.
